requirements.title: Sync and SSE final reply parity
requirements.assertion: Normalized sync reply and streamed terminal reply are equal.

requirements.title: Legacy SSE order
requirements.assertion: Required legacy SSE events and terminal ordering are characterized without reordering.

requirements.title: SOP refresh and resume
requirements.assertion: A waiting SOP remains visible and can continue after History reload.

requirements.title: Conditional graph branches
requirements.assertion: Both true and false legacy branch outcomes are characterized.

requirements.title: Parallel sibling ordering
requirements.assertion: Pending sibling order and merge state are stable.

requirements.title: Pending task resume
requirements.assertion: Completing active work resumes the expected pending task without state loss.

requirements.title: Multiple frame ordering
requirements.assertion: Multiple legacy frames execute in their characterized order.

requirements.title: Reflection retry success
requirements.assertion: A repairable result follows the characterized retry path.

requirements.title: Reflection retry limit
requirements.assertion: An unrepairable result stops at the characterized retry limit.

requirements.title: Knowledge citation recovery
requirements.assertion: Citation content and action remain available after History reload.

requirements.title: Required knowledge before advance
requirements.assertion: A required knowledge node queries before graph advance.

requirements.title: Read-only tool result
requirements.assertion: Read-only tool result, event, and resulting state are characterized.

requirements.title: Side-effect tool replay
requirements.assertion: A repeated side-effect signature reuses the characterized result.

requirements.title: Unknown side-effect status
requirements.assertion: A lost side-effect response is not blindly replayed.

requirements.title: Standalone general skill
requirements.assertion: Standalone General Skill selection, execution, and reply are characterized.

requirements.title: General skill inside SOP
requirements.assertion: General Skill execution returns to the active SOP without losing state.

requirements.title: Transport disconnect semantics
requirements.assertion: Transport disconnect is distinguished from explicit cancellation.

requirements.title: Relay recovery
requirements.assertion: A detached client resumes committed events without duplicate execution.

requirements.title: Explicit cancellation
requirements.assertion: Explicit cancellation produces one stable terminal projection.

requirements.title: Stable runtime failure
requirements.assertion: Runtime failure produces characterized durable and user-visible output.

requirements.title: Handoff creation
requirements.assertion: Declared handoff creates one pending request and stable conversation state.

requirements.title: Handoff refresh
requirements.assertion: Pending handoff is visible after reload.

requirements.title: Handoff reply idempotency
requirements.assertion: Legacy handoff reply behavior and duplicate handling are characterized.

requirements.title: Handoff resume
requirements.assertion: Replying resumes the original Session and persists terminal state.

requirements.title: Scheduled draft refresh
requirements.assertion: Scheduled draft remains actionable after History reload.

requirements.title: Scheduled draft confirmation
requirements.assertion: Legacy scheduled draft confirmation behavior is characterized by source message.

requirements.title: Attachment History recovery
requirements.assertion: Attachment public metadata survives History reload.

requirements.title: Channel projection
requirements.assertion: Channel ingress produces the characterized Message, Event, and Outbox projection.

requirements.title: Scheduled worker projection
requirements.assertion: Scheduled worker execution produces the characterized conversation projection.

requirements.title: Persisted feedback controls
requirements.assertion: Feedback binds to a persisted assistant Message, survives History reload, supports POST and DELETE, and rolls UI state back on command failure.
